turns.text: Hello! I'm the InsurBot AI assistant. I'm an AI — how can I help you today?
Does my home insurance cover water damage from a burst pipe?
Yes, burst pipe water damage is covered under your Hausratversicherung as 'Leitungswasser' damage. Your EUR 250 deductible applies. Is this about an active incident, or a general query?
Happy to help! Is there anything else I can assist with?
Great — have a good day! Your conversation reference is demo_001.
Hello! I'm the InsurBot AI assistant. I'm an AI — how can I help?
I was charged twice this month
I'm sorry to hear that. I can see this needs to be reviewed by our billing team. Can I take your policy number so they have your details ready?
POL-99821. I want to talk to someone now
Of course. Connecting you to a billing specialist — wait time approx. 3 minutes. Reference: demo_002. Handing over now.
